name: Dissent
source:
Dissent is a visual novel with choice-based progression and has a strong narrative focus. We will draw you into the corporate office of Moniker Innovation, where you will uncover mysteries that haunt the halls within. Discover friends, enemies, and uncover the truth behind what Moniker does in the world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1979210/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Dissent》是一部基于选择的视觉小说，具有很强的叙事重点。我们将带你进入Moniker Innovation的公司办公室，在那里你将揭开困扰其内部大厅的谜团。发现朋友、敌人，并揭开Moniker在世界上所做的事情背后的真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1979210/]Steam[/url]]
